snippet.description:
Make it yourself:
12 1” pieces of ginger root, thinly sliced
6 cinnamon sticks
2 star anise
1 teaspoon whole cloves
1 teaspoon allspice
1 tablespoon of vanilla or 1 vanilla bean pod
1 teaspoon green cardamon pods
4 cups water

Add all ingredients into a small pot and simmer on low. If water level gets low top off with more water.

snippet.title: Starbucks: Brewing Innovation, Nurturing Human Connection
snippet.description:
In its early days, Starbucks offered a simple menu featuring café lattes, macchiatos, and espressos. It was during this period that Starbucks became a "third place" where people could relax, enjoy music, and engage in conversations. This experience resonated with customers and started a growth trajectory that surpassed all expectations. However, Starbucks' success isn't just about coffee; it's also about fostering sustainability of the entire coffee supply chain, from seed to cup. More than 25 years ago, Starbucks introduced the Coffee and Farmer Equity (C.A.F.E.) Practices, a verification program emphasizing economic transparency, social responsibility, environmental leadership, and coffee quality. C.A.F.E. Practices have uplifted farmers' lives and promoted responsible coffee cultivation. At Starbucks, innovation isn't limited to store products but extends to enhancing the retail partners’ ability to create magical connections in 36,000 stores worldwide. The Tryer Center, an innovation incubator based inside Starbucks headquarters, brings together designers, scientists, engineers, and baristas from area stores to identify problems and create solutions. This collaborative approach, which includes ideation, prototyping, and refining, ultimately leads to better customer experiences.

*Originally aired on CBS News as part of the Innovators and Disruptors series. Can also be found on GlobalThoughtLeaders.org

snippet.title: Making these PSL-inspired crepes ASAP. 🎃🍂 Recipe in the description.
snippet.description:
Ingredients: 
2-2.5 cups coffee-steeped whole milk
1.5 cups all-purpose flour
2 tbsp melted butter
3 tbsp sugar
4 eggs
1/4 cup pumpkin puree
1 tsp pumpkin spice 
1 tsp vanilla extract 
Pinch of slat 

1. Whist all the ingredients in a bowl, making sure there are no streaks or lumps. Consistency should be like heavy cream. Add 1/2 cup of milk if too thick. 
2. Cover and refrigerate for 30 min-1 hour
3. Heat nonstick pan to medium hear and brush with a little oil. 
4. Ladle batter into pan while swirling with your other hand to make sure the batter covers the entire surface in a very thin layer. 
5. Cook the crepe for 1-2 minutes until edges just start to crisp up. Optional to add a little butter to the pan. 
6. Flip very carefully with a flat spatula or your hands by grabbing the corner of the crepe. 
7. Repeat with the rest of the batter. 
8. For the cream: mix 1 cup heavy cream with 1 tbsp powdered sugar, a dash of cinnamon and a splash of vanilla extract. Whisk until still peaks and roll on top of your crepes. 
Dust with pumpkin spice and enjoy.

#Starbucks #Recipe #Shorts #Pumpkin #PSL
